title: Passage fusion in a generative reader
input: Find original methods where a decoder fuses separately encoded retrieved passages to answer open-domain questions. Exclude joint retriever-generator learning, standalone retrievers, and retrieval benchmark surveys. Background mentions of passage fusion are insufficient.
constraints: 只根据本题授权论文原文判断本篇贡献，缺失证据不凭背景提及补全。
expected_output: 相关论文完整文件名和有原文依据的理由；无匹配可为空。
